svg.title: Which days Polly squawked, by scenario
svg.desc: A grid of 60 days by eight scenarios. A steady flock of about 14 tippers a day squawks on roughly two days in three. A fading flock stops squawking after about two weeks. A ghost town never squawks. With a self-promoter present Polly squawks every day, and the promoter's post wins on the days marked in orange.
svg.text: One square a day for 60 days, at the launch rules.
No squawk: the flock fed less than the target
